notes.title: 「Dorasyeoda」 1.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
「Dorasyeoda」 1.2.1 Patch Notes

🌊Hello, this is Merlin's attic in the development team of Dorasyeoda.
The 1.2.1 Hotfix update  of "Dorasyeoda" was held on May 29rd (Wed).

Table of Contents

 Bug Fixes
 Improvements
 Known Bugs


Bug Fixes
Fixed various in-game bugs and errors.

 It corrects what hasn't been saved.

Improvements
Improvements to the game.

 Other performance is optimized.
 It changes so that the game runs in the background as well. 

Known Bugs
We would like to share the bugs and known issues we are currently aware of.
If you encounter a problem that is not included in the list below, please let us know through Bug Report.

Among these, we plan to prioritize and fix the issues that significantly affect game progression or the players' experience and proceed with updates.
Related to Conversations and Evidence Systems

 When presenting a 'Photo of a Woman' to Yeso, the evidence slot background may not turn gray
 When presenting evidence, previously selected evidence may remain open (occurs when selecting evidence, leaving the interrogation screen, and speaking again)
 Some evidence may reappear after being moved (duplicate acquisition alarms are displayed, but the evidence list does not change)
 After solving a puzzle, you may need to solve it again if you visit another map.
 When presenting the Ornamental Cog to the Grapevine Officer multiple times, the notification that the Leather Scrap was acquired would be displayed multiple times.
 During the True Ending, some of the initial characters of the dialog are not displayed immediately after the full version of events is displayed
Interface related

 Notebook does not open when selecting a dialog option for Hojo's job
 Cogwheel mounting range is small and uncomfortable to drag
 Portals have a small range and are inconvenient to move around
 Different images are displayed when hovering over the Evidence tab after selecting it on the Interrogation screen
 On the accusation screen, the pop-up UI flickers quickly when hovering over people and evidence and then moving the mouse
Other

 Pozole's character information is not being displayed correctly
 Players may be able to move while a cutscene is playing (only in some cases)


Thank you.
From Merlin's Attic

notes.title: 「Dorasyeoda」 1.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
「Dorasyeoda」 1.2.0 Patch Notes

🌊Hello, this is Merlin's attic in the development team of Dorasyeoda.
The 1.2.0 update  of "Dorasyeoda" was held on March 23rd (Sat).

Table of Contents

 New Features
 Improvements
 Bug Fixes
 Known Bugs


New Features

 You can talk to non-primary character (PoJol) (you can't interrogate him, he repeat certain conversations).

Improvements
Improvements to the game.

 The Merlin's Attic logo is now only displayed on the first launch of the game. (When returning to the title by pressing 'Back to Main' in the game, the developer logo is no longer displayed).
 The 'Continue' button is disabled if there are no save slots.
 Empty save slots are grayed out.
 The system name is not displayed in the conversation history, it is displayed in gray centered letters.
 The 'Introduction' record is no longer displayed when viewing the conversation log after entering the Locomotive Factory.
 On the Guessing Results screen, the right column now displays a picture of the cog that was included in the accusation. 

Bug Fixes
Fixed various in-game bugs and errors.

Interface Related

 Fixed a frame break when the Dora Sheeda title logo moves.
 Fixed an issue where the arrows were not positioned correctly on the save slot screen.
 The Credits button is no longer displayed on the main settings screen.
 Fixed white pixels appearing at the edges of image thumbnails in the list in the gallery.
 Fixes images in the gallery not displaying correctly in aspect ratios other than 16:9.
 Fixed the Coming Soon text not being visible on the chapter selector screen.
 Fixed the chapter selector screen disappearing when loading a story.
 Fixed the height of the letters in the place name display UI is skewed upward.
 Fixes the location display UI not printing correctly.
 Fixed the location display UI appearing on top of the newest.
 Fixed not being able to close the chat history when clicking on it during reminiscence.
 The position of the scroll is no longer displayed correctly in the chat history intermittently.
 Name decorations are no longer displayed overlapping on the Character Info tab in the Cluebook.
 The Map tab in the Cluebook will no longer be unclickable.
 Fixed a bug where the back screen could be manipulated when presenting evidence during an interrogation.

Saving Related

 Fixed sound settings being reset when returning to the main in game.

Ending Related

 Fixed the Rank of Renewal appearing black after an accusation.
 Fixed an issue in Ending 3 where the image of the Grapevine is visible.

Miscellaneous

 Fixed some dialog misspellings.
 After solving the puzzle in the President's office, closing the drawer will no longer cause the game to freeze.
 Fixed an effect not being applied to the production screen showing the map.

Known Bugs
We would like to share the bugs and known issues we are currently aware of.
If you encounter a problem that is not included in the list below, please let us know through Bug Report.

Among these, we plan to prioritize and fix the issues that significantly affect game progression or the players' experience and proceed with updates.
Related to Conversations and Evidence Systems

 When presenting a 'Photo of a Woman' to Yeso, the evidence slot background may not turn gray
 When presenting evidence, previously selected evidence may remain open (occurs when selecting evidence, leaving the interrogation screen, and speaking again)
 Some evidence may reappear after being moved (duplicate acquisition alarms are displayed, but the evidence list does not change)
 After solving a puzzle, you may need to solve it again if you visit another map.
 When presenting the Ornamental Cog to the Grapevine Officer multiple times, the notification that the Leather Scrap was acquired would be displayed multiple times.
 During the True Ending, some of the initial characters of the dialog are not displayed immediately after the full version of events is displayed
Interface related

 Notebook does not open when selecting a dialog option for Hojo's job
 Cogwheel mounting range is small and uncomfortable to drag
 Portals have a small range and are inconvenient to move around
 Different images are displayed when hovering over the Evidence tab after selecting it on the Interrogation screen
 On the accusation screen, the pop-up UI flickers quickly when hovering over people and evidence and then moving the mouse
Other

 Pozole's character information is not being displayed correctly
 Players may be able to move while a cutscene is playing (only in some cases)


Thank you.
From Merlin's Attic

notes.title: 「Dorasyeoda」 1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
「Dorasyeoda」 1.1.1 Patch Notes

🌊Hello, this is Merlin's attic in the development team of Dorasyeoda.
The 1.1.1 update  of "Dorasyeoda" was held on January 5th (Fri).

Table of Contents

 New Features
 Bug Fixes
 Known Bugs


New Features

 A feature to adjust the volume of voice has been added

Bug Fixes
Various in-game bugs and errors have been fixed.

Evidence Acquisition Related

 The issue where evidence that changes status reappears on the map even after being acquired has been fixed
UI Related

 The issue where UI can be clicked to interact with the map behind it has been fixed.
 The issue where the background music volume slider in the settings was incorrectly adjusted after loading the game has been fixed.
  The issue where the chapter selection window might not display correctly at certain screen ratios has been fixed.
 The issue where the settings window might not function properly from the main screen has been fixed.
 The issue where the dialogue history window does not display correctly when pressing the L key has been fixed.
 The issue where UI elements like Kim CheongJeong's portrait and safes could appear in front of the pause menu has been fixed.
 The issue where the close button was not visible in Kim CheongJeong's portrait has been fixed.
 The issue where Kim CheongJeong's portrait, safes, and other UI elements could not be closed by pressing the ESC key has been fixed.
 The issue where already seen dialogues might not be displayed in gray has been fixed.
Others

 The issue where the 'Come Here' sign and NPC shadows are displayed in front of the SaeGyeol character has been fixed.
 The issue where presenting the 'Someone's Letter' item to GilChan would display DoSeob's illustration has been fixed.
 The issue where the evidence presentation window might unintentionally open when trying to talk to a character has been fixed.
 The issue where photos not acquired were displayed in the gallery has been fixed.

Known Bugs
We would like to share the bugs and known issues we are currently aware of.
If you encounter a problem that is not included in the list below, please let us know through Bug Report.

Among these, we plan to prioritize and fix the issues that significantly affect game progression or the players' experience and proceed with updates.

 The issue where a notification of obtaining evidence appears every time you present a decorative gear to PoDoGunGwan.
 The issue where the player can move during some cutscenes.
 The issue where only part of the dialogue is displayed before and after the full story of the incident in the ending.
 The issue where the action is awkward and can get stuck when climbing a ladder.
 The issue where you cannot re-enter the portal immediately after leaving the president's office.
 The issue where the description box flickers quickly when moving the mouse over characters or evidence in the accusation screen.
 The issue where you have to solve the puzzle again when revisiting the map after solving a puzzle.
 The issue where the safe in the management office is not acquired properly.
 The issue where gallery photos may not display correctly at different screen ratios.
 The issue where no sound comes from the buttons during save/load.
 The incorrect spelling in some dialogues.
 The intermittent issue where the reasoning notebook does not close with the close button (if this occurs, please close it with the ESC key or restart the game.)
The issue of 'the game may freeze when exiting the accusation screen' is currently being investigated. If you encounter this issue, please report it in more detail through Bug Report or the Steam community, and we will take swift action.


Thank you.
From Merlin's Attic
